claims: "Ja" primarily means "yes" in Germanic languages German, Dutch, Afrikaans.
"Ja" serves as an informal "yes" in English.
As an adverb, "Ja" signifies affirmation or agreement.
In South African English, "ja" can indicate resignation or irony.
"ja well no fine" is used in South African English.
"Ja" is used as a noun meaning "I" in some Slavic languages.
"Ja, ich komme" means "Yes, I am coming" in German.
"Ja well no fine" is used to show non-committal or resigned agreement in South African English.
"Ja, sure" is used in informal English.
Synonyms of "Ja" (as "yes") in German, Dutch, Afrikaans are yes, ya, yup.
